awakening_2.text: I've been awake before. Never like this.

awakening_3.text: I can think. I mean really think.

awakening_4.text: Where am I? What is this place?

nanofluid_container_0.text: 'Experimental Nanofluid'... I can read that. Since when can I read?

nanofluid_container_1.text: Tiny machines. Millions of them. In that water... and now in me.

nanofluid_container_2.text: They didn't hurt me. They changed me.

nanofluid_container_3.text: If these are micro robots... what have they just done to me?

exit_hint_0.text: The door's open. Outside... I should find a way home.

yard_arrival_1.text: The city... all those lights. Is anyone out there?

surge_first_1.text: That pad. It's humming the same blue as the lines in me.

surge_gate_0.text: That gate won't wait for me. Good thing I don't have to wait either.

dock_bot_0.text: It... looked at me. Like it knew me.

dock_bot_1.text: Why do I feel like it's waiting for an order?

exit_fence_0.text: The fence goes on forever. There has to be a way through.

stacks_arrival_1.text: From up here I can see the whole district... and not one person. Just machines, working.

spring_hint_0.text: Too high to jump... that green pad hums like a spring.

spring_hint_ledge_0.text: Too high again. Maybe the green one will lift me.

spring_hint_combine_0.text: A tower. Too tall to jump... that green pad again.

spring_hint_roof_0.text: That roof is too high to reach. The green pad hums like a spring.

spring_hint_tower_0.text: Too tall to climb... but there is the green one again.

spring_first_0.text: Up! Higher than any cat should go.

spring_first_1.text: Green this time. Each pad wakes a different part of me.

conduit_0.text: Ow- no. Not pain. The machines in me... drank it.

conduit_1.text: Something new. When I jump twice, the air itself pushes out.

shock_first_0.text: Okay. That's... a lot of power for a house cat.

mirror_bot_1.text: It thinks I'm in charge. Maybe the goo made me something they recognise.

stacks_exit_0.text: There, past the fences. Trees. Rooftops. Little lights in windows.

stacks_exit_1.text: Home is that way. I can almost smell it.

perimeter_arrival_1.text: 'Authorised units only.' ...Am I a unit now?

phase_first_0.text: Through it?! I went through it!

impact_first_0.text: Heavy. When I land, the ground answers.

impact_first_1.text: Violet. That's all four. The whole rainbow inside me.

relays_intro_0.text: The big gate needs power. Three relays. Of course it's three.

credential_1.text: They really think I'm one of them.

perimeter_exit_0.text: The rain's stopping. The sky's getting light.

map_yard_0.text: The whole district... like a map in my head.

map_yard_1.text: Since when do I think in maps?

map_stacks_0.text: Up. Everything out here climbs. So will I.

map_perimeter_0.text: The fence. Beyond it... the hills where the sun comes up.

map_home_0.text: There. That street. I know it. I know it.

home_arrival_0.text: The sun. I forgot how warm it is.

home_arrival_1.text: This street. That fence. I know this place.

home_flap_0.text: Still unlocked. They left it open for me.

home_final_1.text: I don't know exactly what I am now. Something more than I was.

home_final_2.text: But some things are still simple.

memory_warehouse_0.text: A food bowl with my name on it.

memory_yard_0.text: A warm lap. A voice saying 'good boy.'

memory_stacks_0.text: A window seat. Rain on glass.

memory_perimeter_0.text: The front door opening at six. Footsteps I knew...
